title: shared gpu develop pipeline
description:
Commit (b) of the pipeline mission: the preview session completes its
cutover to gles/GpuDevelopPipeline and the duplicated chain bodies die.

GlesPreviewSession.cpp (2295 -> 1075 lines) keeps only what is
preview-specific: the session's own window-capable EGL (raw handles,
the config KEPT for eglCreateWindowSurface), the GL thread + the
bounded one-job handoff (Render + Surface kinds) with the latched
failure semantics VERBATIM, the session's OWN window program (the
pipeline's vertex shader is pipeline-private), the window present
(best-effort, never fails the frame), the stats pack (the session's
own small RGBA8 scratch pair + FBOs + SSBO readback + toByte quantize
+ row-flip pack) and the statsEnabled toggle. The twelve chain+store
programs, every chain uniform location, the static texture-unit map
(0 CFA / 1 pass source, also store + window / 2 scratch / 3 shading /
4 guide / 5 LUT),
changed: refactor: sessions slim to the pipeline
